summary: Codex's PostToolUse nudge. Verified this session by diffing it against hooks/nudge-handler.mjs: the two files are byte-identical apart from two header-comment lines (the filename and the name of the PreToolUse guard). It is a maintained copy, not a re-implementation, so any detector change must be applied to both in the same commit or Codex silently keeps the old behaviour. Cursor has no third copy — hooks/cursor-nudge-handler.mjs delegates here, so this file is the one that governs two of the three hosts.
